jazzercise sarasota sara dance center.name: Nina Schlachter
jazzercise sarasota sara dance center.text:
Jazzercise is the best kind of exercise I have ever done.
If you love to dance but don’t want to go to a gym, this is for you.  Our dances incorporate cardio with strength training, resistance and balance.
If the idea of forming a welcoming, smiling “gang” to exercise with and love the idea of finding some new friends as a bonus, this is for you.  Our leader makes everyone feel included  and is always creating special events and activities to create our community.
And here in Venice and Sarasota, we are blessed to have the absolutely best teacher in the world Karen Schroll.   Even if you don’t have a sense of rhythm, her cueing steps is perfect.  Even if you feel self conscious dancing, no one cares and no one compares - we’re all at different levels.  And there is absolutely no embarrassment or shame, she speaks in terms of “high intensity” or “low intensity” when curing steps - no suggestion of can you or can’t you do a step.
This is exercise!?  This is fun!!
jazzercise sarasota sara dance center.responseFromOwnerText: Nina we can't thank you enough for this GLOWING review!  We are SO grateful for this incredible community & that YOU are in it!  & we love that you feel safe & confident & welcomed in classes because that is what we strive for!

Working with Josh has been absolutely life-changing. With his guidance, support, and expertise, I have lost 75 pounds and am now in the best shape of my life.

His training approach is thoughtful, motivating, and focused not just on weight loss, but on building strength, mobility, and confidence. Because of his program, I now have the stamina, flexibility, and conditioning needed to train and compete in ballroom dance at a high level.

What truly sets him apart is how invested he is in his clients success. He pushes you to become stronger while always making sure your form, safety, and long-term health come first.

Thanks to Josh’s training, my performance, endurance, and overall physical ability have improved tremendously. I feel stronger, more energized, and more confident every day, and it has made a huge difference in my training and performance on the dance floor.

I’m incredibly grateful for his support and highly recommend Josh to anyone looking to improve their fitness and elevate their performance

thavma yoga lakewood ranch.name: Jenny Ferraro
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.text:
This Yoga Teacher Training was one of the most meaningful things I’ve done for myself in a very long time. After years of pouring my energy into raising my children and taking care of everyone else, I felt a quiet pull to finally do something just for me. Signing up for this training ended up being such a gift.

The experience was so much more than learning how to teach yoga poses. It became a journey of self-discovery, personal growth, and reconnecting with myself in a deeper way. I gained confidence, a deeper understanding of the practice, and a real appreciation for the philosophy behind yoga.

Another unexpected gift was the group of people I went through the training with. We supported each other through the entire journey, and I truly feel like the friendships formed during this training will last a lifetime.

I’m especially grateful for the encouragement and guidance from Marina. Her knowledge, patience, and passion for yoga created such a supportive environment to learn and grow.

I left this training not only feeling prepared to teach, but also feeling stronger, more grounded, and inspired in my own life. I’m incredibly grateful for the experience and would recommend this training to anyone who feels that quiet whisper inside telling them it’s time to grow.
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.title: Thavma Yoga Lakewood Ranch

thavma yoga lakewood ranch.name: Michael VanBuskirk
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.text: I had been through a traumatic injury back in October. I shattered my heel and burst my L1 in my back. Through PT and the right medication, I recovered pretty quickly.  However it was getting back to Thavma that helped me gain all my confidence back.  I started back at TY in early January and by early March I was skiing again! This had nothing to do with PT and everything to do with Marina and her teacher’s core and balance work.  Thanks Thavma, for getting me back to my true passion. Skiing!!!
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.title: Thavma Yoga Lakewood Ranch

thavma yoga lakewood ranch.name: Jasmine Hasler
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.text: I had such a great experience today at Thavma Yoga in Lakewood Ranch. It was my first time at the studio and my very first heated yoga class and I honestly couldn’t have felt more welcomed. The energy in the studio immediately put me into a good vibe which was especially helpful since I wasn’t sure what to expect as a first timer. The class was challenging — but in the best way. It pushed me & of course, made me sweat, but it was also fun and empowering. Marina, the owner and instructor, is incredible. She has this way about her that makes the class feel intentionally personal, almost like you’re getting a one-on-one session. She thoughtfully corrects posture and encourages you to go a little deeper but in a non judgmental, motivating way. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and proud of myself!  It's only been an hour and I’m already looking through my schedule for the week ahead to plan my next visit! Her cute puppies also added an extra endorphin boost <3
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review 🤍
We’re truly honored you chose Thavma for your very first heated yoga experience,that’s a big step, and we’re so glad you felt welcomed and supported from the moment you walked in.
Marina’s whole passion behind creating Thavma is for people to feel exactly what you felt , that powerful shift from uncertainty to strength, from just “getting through” a workout to truly connecting to your body. After rebuilding her own body through injury, her mission became helping others feel strong, capable, aligned, and confident in a way that lasts.
Hearing that you left feeling rejuvenated and proud of yourself means everything to us. That’s the Thavma effect!
And yes… the studio pups definitely are part of the experience 🐾
We can’t wait to have you back in the room soon. Welcome to the Thavma community,  you absolutely belong here.
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.title: Thavma Yoga Lakewood Ranch

thavma yoga lakewood ranch.name: Declan Keenan
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.text: Attending Thavma Yoga Studio worked wonders for my lower back pain. I strongly urge anyone with that problem to do the same. It wasn't instant gratification, took some time and persistence but the stretching and strengthening eventually paid off. I recently read that there are strong tendons which anchor the base of your spine. As we get older, these tendons can prevent the muscles in that area from moving correctly so they get more and more stiff and sore. It is essential to get these muscles moving again but in an educated and safe manner. I have told many people about this back pain (and more) cure which is available at Thavma. It's there waiting!
thavma yoga lakewood ranch.responseFromOwnerText: Declan, thank you so much for taking the time to share this. Your words truly mean a lot to us. We love that you highlighted the importance of patience and consistency—real, lasting change in the body happens when movement is done with intention and education, not shortcuts. Seeing you regain mobility, strength, and confidence in your back is exactly why Thavma exists. Thank you for trusting the process and for sharing it with others. We’re so grateful to have you as part of our community 🤍

embodied health.name: Alex Rutland
embodied health.text:
This isn’t a “menu of upgrades” spa—it’s a therapeutic wellness studio where yoga therapy, Ayurveda, and massage are blended thoughtfully around what your body actually needs that day. No nickel-and-diming for tools like hot stones, cupping, gua sha, or aromatherapy—they’re included when clinically helpful, which tells you their focus is outcomes, not upsells.
The intake feels personal and professional, and the session (75 minutes) was that rare mix of precise and nurturing. The therapist combined neuromuscular and Thai-style stretching with targeted work on my shoulders and low back, and finished with calming breathwork cues from yoga therapy. Result: immediate range-of-motion improvement and that grounded, parasympathetic “ahh” you hope for but rarely get.
What sets them apart is integrated care. They genuinely combine massage, yoga therapy, and Ayurvedic bodywork to support pain relief, nervous-system regulation, and long-term habits—not just a one-off feel-good hour.
Transparent, smart packages: Their Svastha and Sadhaka packages bundle an intake, massage(s), private yoga sessions, and between-visit support/resources so your progress doesn’t stall between appointments. It’s a cost-effective way to build a plan instead of chasing random sessions.
Highly trained: Denver Clark (yoga therapist/massage therapist; Heartwood Yoga Institute / Sarasota School of Massage) leads with a whole-person approach across modalities like deep tissue, neuromuscular, prenatal, reflexology, and more. That depth shows up in the work.
Clean, calm space & easy booking by appointment only at 2446 Manatee Ave E, Bradenton, and online booking is straightforward. License/MM# is posted (MM45313), which I always appreciate for professionalism.
If you’re dealing with stress, chronic pain, PTSD/anxiety, or you simply want bodywork that actually changes how you move and feel, start here. Book the therapeutic massage or one of their wellness packages, follow their home practices for a week, and notice how your baseline shifts. Embodied Health is the real deal.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding First Experience at F45 at Lakewood Ranch East

I had my first workout at an F45 and it was an absolutely fantastic experience. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming, energetic, and incredibly supportive. The trainers and the entire group made it easy to jump right in—even as a first-timer.

What stood out the most was how encouraging and judgment-free the environment was. The trainers took time to help me with my form during several movements to make sure I was doing everything correctly and safely, which I really appreciated. It never felt intimidating—just motivating.

The workout itself was challenging but fun, and the energy in the room kept everyone pushing through together. It truly felt like a team effort rather than just another gym session.

And let me tell you—it worked! I was sore for two days, which is always a good sign that it was a great workout.

I can’t wait to come back and train again the next time I’m in town. If you’re looking for a motivating workout with an amazing community, F45 Lakewood Ranch East definitely a must-visit! 💪🔥

orangetheory fitness.name: Lucas P
orangetheory fitness.text:
Came here to try the class and was planning to start off with a series of 10 classes, but fortunately I got to experience how awfully they treated my girlfriend and what a nightmare she went through, particularly because of Cal, Meghan, and Brooklyn.  We believe that Cal, Meghan, and Brooklyn retaliated after we mentioned in a review that no one was answering phone calls. At the time, we specifically omitted why... however, given the circumstances, I would like to disclose that the reason. Staff is not answering phone calls because they join the exercise classes instead of being at the front desk and working.

In retaliation, Cal and Meghan went out of their way to make my girlfriend's cancelation of her membership difficult. After my gf had cancelled her membership, her card was still charged. On February 20th, my gf spoke with Cal and asked him to return the additional $179 that was charged for a renewed membership, even though it was cancelled. He lied about cancelling her membership and refunding this amount; it never happened.

On March 19, her card was once again charged the $179 renewal. Again she spoke to Cal, who said he would speak to the manager (Meghan) and call back. Five days passed and he never called her back, nor did Meghan.

On March 24, she called them again and Cal answered. He said that he did not have a chance to speak with Meghan, the manager, and that he would leave her a note to call me back.

On the morning of March 25, 2025, after not receiving a call from Meghan or anyone at Orangetheory,  she called Orangetheory again and Brooklyn answered. She asked Brooklyn to cancel the $179.00 March 18, 2025 credit card charge for the month of April.  Brooklyn told her that she is unable to cancel the March 18, 2025 charge, because there is a 30-day cancellation policy and that I would have had to submit a cancellation request within 30-day of the charge. This made absolutely no sense, since (1) Cal already cancelled my entire Orangetheory membership a month prior in February and (2) March 25, 2025, the day she called Brooklyn to cancel this charge, was within 30-days of the March 18, 2025 charge.  She tried to explain to Brooklyn that her membership was already cancelled and that the March 18, 2025 charge must have been an automated mistake. Brooklyn could not be reasoned with. She once again just told me that the charge could not be removed.

She asked Brooklyn to please ask Meghan to call her. Brooklyn said she would. No one called my gf back.

Finally, later that day, March 25, 2025, around 5:40 PM, my gf called Orangetheory and Meghan picked up. Meghan also could not be reasoned with. She said the same thing that Brooklyn said and that my gf had to submit a cancellation request that would take 30 days to process. My gf tried to explain to her that she already cancelled her membership with Cal back in February and that the March 18, 2025 charge was unauthorized. Meghan was extremely rude and kept repeating herself and saying that she would not remove the charge. My gf let her know that clearly we are not understanding each other and demanded that Meghan remove the charge and cancel her membership with Orangetheory and, if she fails to remove the charge, I will dispute the charge and report this incident to the Better Business Bureau. She stated my gf was no longer welcome at Orangetheory, but that she would not return my gf's money even though my gf can no longer use Orangetheory services.

Meghan failed to remove the charge and failed to send me a copy of my contract.

I observed this entire debacle as it progressed in horror. Cal, Meghan, and Brooklyn have no business working in customer service and are vindictive and vile. Also, employees should be working during business hours and not participating in fitness classes and leaving the front desk unattended.

As a result of this, my mom and I both opted out of joining Orange Theory and, of course, my gf left as well. We've been asked about our experience at OT by our family friends as well and we've shared this experience with them.
orangetheory fitness.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience, Lucas. We’re truly sorry to hear about the frustration and difficulty your girlfriend faced regarding her membership and communication with our staff. This is not the experience we strive to provide, and we take these concerns seriously.

We’d like to look into this further and ensure it’s properly addressed. Please consider reaching out to our studio directly or emailing us at studiomanager0254@orangetheoryfitness.com so we can investigate what happened and work toward a resolution. We appreciate the feedback, it helps us improve.

lft gym.name: Savanah Mullen
lft gym.text:
LFT is a great athlete community! I love the structured coaching and the flexibility to choose between more traditional barbell-based strength and conditioning or higher-intensity plyometric-style workouts. Each session wraps up with a longer aerobic component, which adds great balance.

It’s like CrossFit but with a bit more structure and predictability, and without the high-skill gymnastics. The programming is smart, scalable, and effective. Whether you’re just getting back into training or looking to push yourself to the next level, LFT offers something for everyone. Highly recommend!

The coaches helped me overcome my insecurities, fears and have safely pushed me to limits I’ve never been pushed to before! The people, atmosphere and my weightlifting progress has caused me to absolutely love this gym!

They have also helped me with modifications so that I don’t get injured, at the same time they have helped me to be independent! They don’t baby you but they are also not scary and mean - I hope that helps to anyone considering :) I promise it’s not as intimidating as it looks!

Ps. One of my favorite things is seeing everyone push themselves. Absolutely everyone during class is giving it their all, even the people like myself that are new and feel like they are “behind”!

dsc osprey.name: Katy Clouatre
dsc osprey.text:
DSC Osprey is everything I’ve been looking for! I’ve been coming to Osprey for the past eight years and could never find a gym that truly fit my needs until now. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and motivating.

As a personal trainer myself, I know how hard it can be to find the right fit, but DSC Osprey exceeded all of my expectations. The workouts were challenging yet supportive, and I genuinely had a blast.

Thank you, DSC Osprey. I can’t wait to come back!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText: Katy, you're so awesome!  Thank you for the kind words and we can't wait till you come back too!!  Safe travels
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Christina Kobe
dsc osprey.text: According to Harvard Health, age related muscle loss can begin around 35 years old at the rate of 1-2% for the typical person.  I felt stronger in one week after working with the dynamic DSC coaches.  I’ve always been committed to physical fitness and the DSC 55 minute workout provides the biggest bang for your time.   If you want to stay strong in the years ahead, I strongly encourage checking out DSC .  You will feel stronger after one week.  Take advantage of the generous introductory offer and judge for yourself.  Hope to see you there!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText:
Christina, this made my whole day! 🙌
You perfectly captured what we're all about - that "finish strong" feeling is exactly what we hope every member carries with them out the door. I love that you mentioned the modifications because that's truly at the heart of what we do. Your body, your workout, your victory.
Thank you for trusting us to be part of your fitness journey. Can't wait to see what you conquer next!
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Flo Tel
dsc osprey.text: DSC Osprey does a terrific job of motivating participants with enthusiastic trainers, varying programming, and upbeat music!  Highly recommend that anyone tries out their free trial to meet the trainers and other participants.  I tried, loved, and signed up!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing this, Flo😉 We’re so glad you decided to give DSC Osprey a try. Your energy and coachability shine through every session, and it’s been such a joy getting to know you. We love that you bring the same enthusiasm you have for tennis into your training here—it adds so much to our DSC Family. Excited to keep supporting you and celebrating all the progress ahead!
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Cait P
dsc osprey.text: I absolutely love this gym! The instructors are amazing and actually know what they are doing. They instruct you on the movements and ensure you are doing them correctly to prevent injury. Every exercise is meant to target something! This was a must for me when choosing a new gym; I hate going to a gym and feeling like I am doing some weird movement that is not necessary. I love being able to do strength and cardio on separate days. The cardio days are not just jumping around, you actually have targeted movements that raise your heart rate. I have some prior injuries that often are irritated. I really appreciate the instructors remembering and checking in without having to stand there and wait for them. They are very attentive and the class sizes are a max of 12, so you feel like you are getting individual attention in every class. I have tried all different types of gyms since I left the military (Burn, Orangetheory, ISI, boutique gyms, Pilates, Barre) and nothing compares to this experience. 100% would recommend to anyone. Oh and I have lost 4lbs since I started 3 weeks ago!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your fantastic review! We're thrilled to hear that our instructors have made such a positive impact on your fitness journey and that you appreciate their attention to detail and individualized support. It's great to know that our targeted workouts are helping you achieve your goals safely and effectively. Congratulations on your weight loss—what an amazing achievement in just three weeks! We look forward to continuing to support you in your fitness endeavors.
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Jacqueline Motroni
dsc osprey.text: Absolutely fabulous place to workout! The staff is educated! Not like took a weekend course in training like actually degree educated! I learn something new here everyday! Yet they are so down to earth and make you feel like family. Freaking love this place. My kid does too!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText:
Jacqui!!
This just brought the biggest smile to my face - thank you so much for these incredibly kind words!
You and Robbie are honestly two of our favorite people to have around. Your energy is absolutely contagious, and even when you're grumbling about lower days, you still show up and give it everything you've got. That says so much about who you are.
It means the world to us that you feel like family here - because that's exactly how we see you both. Watching Robbie grow as an athlete while you're right there working just as hard on your own goals... there's something really special about that.
We're just so grateful you chose to be part of our little gym family. Thank you for bringing your amazing spirit (and humor!) to every session.
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Stacey Palosky
dsc osprey.text: About five years ago, I re-picked up fitness at Orange Theory. 1000 classes later, I realized that I needed to shake things up a bit. DSC Osprey has reinvigorated my energy for getting to the gym. The coaches are top-notch and there are so many and varied strength, mobility, and conditioning moves that we do. The coaches always deal well with my injury, so I rarely leave the gym in pain- a nice change. In just my first 6 weeks, I lost more than 2% body fat AND kept my muscles intact. Not too shabby for a 50-something who also works full-time.
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText:
Stacey!
Wow, 1000+ Orange Theory classes - that's incredible dedication! We feel so honored that after all that experience, you chose to give us a try and shake things up.
Your positivity and that amazing smile you bring to every session truly lights up our gym. Watching you embrace new movements and push yourself while we work around your injury has been such a joy. You tackle everything with such grace and determination.
Those results you're seeing? That's all YOU and your hard work paying off. We're just grateful we get to be part of your fitness journey and that you're feeling good leaving the gym instead of in pain.
Thank you for bringing such wonderful energy to our community, Stacey. Having members like you who work so incredibly hard and always greet everyone with that bright smile makes what we do feel like the best job in the world.
See you soon!
Daria & the team
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Vickie Gibbs
dsc osprey.text:
I am absolutely thrilled with this gym.
They support and encourage you.
I have been to local gyms and palates and they were all a one size fits all.
I have a damaged lower back and shoulders from work.
Every exercise they personally gave me is so I do not get injured.
If I could give them 100 Stars, I would.
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText:
Vickie!!  Thank you so much for your kind words! We're absolutely thrilled that you've found a fitness home with us. Your experience perfectly captures what we strive for - personalized attention that acknowledges each person's unique needs. Working with members like you who have specific considerations for their lower back and shoulders reminds us why we take the time to modify exercises and provide individualized guidance.

It means the world to hear that you feel supported and encouraged. That's exactly the environment we aim to create, where fitness is accessible to everyone regardless of their starting point or physical limitations.

Your enthusiasm (and those 100 stars!) makes all our hard work worthwhile. We're honored to be part of your fitness journey and look forward to continuing to support you every step of the way.

Thank you for being such a valued member of our DSC family!  Keep being awesome!!!

- The DSC Team
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Chuck Hodge
dsc osprey.text: Hard/Rewarding.  Challenging/Effective.  Difficult/Educational.  Painful/Fun.  Challenging work outs lead by knowledgeable staff who provide exceptional advice during workouts.  Highly recommend.  Love the results!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText: Chuck!  Thank you for your thoughtful review! You've perfectly captured what we aim for - workouts that challenge you while delivering real results. We're proud of our knowledgeable coaching team and their ability to provide valuable guidance during sessions. It's great to hear you're seeing the benefits of your hard work. We appreciate your recommendation and are glad to have you as part of our community!
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

dsc osprey.name: Brandi
dsc osprey.text:
I love this gym!!! I recently moved to the area and discovered this gym nearby, so I signed up for the free week. I'm so glad I did. The instructors are knowledgeable, the equipment and space are excellent, the workouts are challenging, and everyone is super friendly.

I've been coming here for 4 months now and I feel stronger than ever. I haven't been this consistent with my workouts in a long time, and that's because I hate missing a workout now. Thank you DSC Osprey!
dsc osprey.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow - this review just made our day! Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience with us.

It's members like you who remind us why we do what we do. Hearing that you're feeling stronger than ever and actually look forward to your workouts is exactly what we aim for! That consistency is where the real magic happens, and we couldn't be prouder to be part of your fitness journey.

Our coaches work incredibly hard to create an environment where everyone feels welcome while still being challenged appropriately. I'll be sure to share your kind words with our entire team - they'll be thrilled!

We're so grateful you took that leap and tried our free week. Having you as part of our fitness family these past 4 months has been wonderful, and we can't wait to see what you accomplish next!
dsc osprey.title: DSC Osprey

pr1me fitness.text:
I’ve had such a great experience at Pr1me. It really is a one-stop shop for health and fitness. The workouts are great, the coaches are very knowledgeable, and the atmosphere is welcoming and motivating.

What I love most is that it’s not just a gym. After workouts I’ve been able to use the recovery services like the infrared sauna and cold plunge, which help a lot with soreness and recovery. The team has also helped me rehab my shoulder, showing me the right exercises and movements so I could get stronger without pain.

Everything you need is in one place—fitness, recovery, and expert coaching. The coaches really care about their members and take the time to help you move better and feel better.

I highly recommend Pr1me to anyone looking for more than a typical gym!

pr1me fitness.text: Prime is truly all they proclaim and more. I personally love how interactive and involved the coaches are. They truly truly care about each and every one’s personal well being and development. They emphasize the importance of proper form and make sure everyone has a good foundation. I have personally experienced other gyms where coaches do not care too much about good form and just are there to provide you a workout and call it a day. Prime is not even close to that. I am just really thankful for their care for every person and their development and of course, a great workout! Highly recommend this gym!

pr1me fitness.searchString: Pr1me F1tness 1820 59th street west Bradenton Florida
pr1me fitness.name: Cindy Quinn
pr1me fitness.text:
I am having a fantastic experience at Prime Fitness! The gym has a great atmosphere and the classes are always well organized, challenging, and fun.
Marc is an outstanding trainer—knowledgeable, motivating, and genuinely invested in helping everyone improve no matter their fitness level. He pushes you in the best way while still making the workouts enjoyable.
If you’re looking for great classes and a trainer who really cares about your progress, I highly recommend Prime Fitness and training with Marc!
pr1me fitness.title: Pr1me Fitness

pr1me fitness.searchString: Pr1me F1tness 1820 59th street west Bradenton Florida
pr1me fitness.name: M A (Hi Life Athletics)
pr1me fitness.text:
I’ve honestly been waiting for something like this for 15 years.

In my 40s now, my focus has shifted. It’s not just about working out hard anymore — it’s about training for longevity, better recovery, and long-term quality of life. Pr1me is exactly that.

The Human Optimization Protocol is what sets this place apart. It’s not random workouts. It’s structured, intentional training combined with recovery, testing, and guidance that actually makes sense for someone who wants to perform well now and still feel great 20 years from today.

I feel stronger, I recover faster, and I finally feel like my training is aligned with my long-term health — not just short-term results.

If you’re in your 40s (or getting there) and you care about performance, recovery, and staying athletic for life, this is it.
pr1me fitness.title: Pr1me Fitness

pr1me fitness.searchString: Pr1me F1tness 1820 59th street west Bradenton Florida
pr1me fitness.name: SKF
pr1me fitness.text: These guys really know what they are doing. Great workouts to take your fittness to the next level. This is not bootcamp- just good solid training with excellent instructors.  Nice people- I highly recommend.
pr1me fitness.title: Pr1me Fitness

pr1me fitness.searchString: Pr1me F1tness 1820 59th street west Bradenton Florida
pr1me fitness.name: Corrina Zimmermann
pr1me fitness.text:
PR1ME Fitness in Bradenton is hands down one of the best gyms I’ve trained at. Coach Trish and Coach Marc provide exceptional coaching — attentive, knowledgeable, and truly invested in helping you improve safely and effectively.

I especially love the Longevity classes. They’ve helped me stay resilient, mobile, and keep my joints healthy. The 50-minute class length is perfect — long enough to feel accomplished without rushing through movements, which I believe reduces injury risk compared to shorter workouts.

The facility is clean, professional, and welcoming. The community is friendly and supportive, whether you’re new or training for competition.

The recovery options are a huge bonus — the red light therapy and Dr. Byron’s PEMF machine have been game-changers. I’m pain-free, my knee pain is gone, and I feel fully prepared for HYROX training.

If you’re looking for a high-performance gym in Bradenton that focuses on longevity, strength, recovery, and real results, PR1ME Fitness is it.
pr1me fitness.title: Pr1me Fitness

I’ve been a member at Outdoor Group Fitness for almost a year now, and I can confidently say—I couldn’t be happier.

I’ve been in the fitness world for over 20 years (honestly, my whole life), and I’ve never experienced a gym like this.

OGF isn’t just a place to work out. It’s a place where:

You’re supported
You’re seen
You’re pushed (in the best way)
You’re genuinely cared for

f45 training lakewood ranch north.name: Nicholas LaBrecque
f45 training lakewood ranch north.text:
I'll write my review as verbose as their program and membership descriptions.

Get your review on, now with our ultimate review package and great review capabilities!!! Where the words fly and results are top of the bell curve! Experience the pinnacle of fitness adjacency: a premium, boutique, hyper-functional something that lasts for a number of minutes divisible by… confidence.

Stepping into F45 (which might stand for “Fitness 45,” “Feelings x 45,” or “Figure it out in 45”), I was immediately greeted by the unmistakable aura of structured potential. The programming is clearly designed around exercises, probably in sets, that almost certainly occur in a sequence—expertly curated to deliver outcomes of a measurable nature, presumably.

Membership options? Absolutely available. There are tiers—maybe two, maybe seven—each meticulously priced at amounts that exist. You can choose the plan that best fits your lifestyle, budget, and tolerance for ambiguity. Want details? So do I! Fortunately, everything is explained somewhere, possibly during a complimentary consultation that will clarify everything in the same way fog clarifies a lighthouse.

The classes combine movements of the upper body, lower body, and the mysterious third body (core?), synchronized with timers that beep at meaningful intervals. Coaching is present—definitively there—providing feedback with words, gestures, and motivating encouragement such as “Yes!” and “Keep going!” which, in fairness, are both true and applicable to many situations.

Results? Off the charts. Which chart? Great question. The F45 chart. It measures progress along the axes of “Wow” and “Nice,” culminating in a personal best that you’ll recognize when you feel it, or when someone tells you that you have.

Facilities are state-of-the-art in a way that transcends mere states and mere art. Equipment is used. Mats are matting. Kettlebells kettlebell with a kettlebell-forward philosophy. You’ll love the vibe, which exists at the intersection of energetic and present.

Pricing transparency is so transparent you can’t even see it. It’s practically a ghost—haunting your curiosity, whispering, “Ask in person.” When you do, a friendly human will outline options with words like “flexible,” “unlimited,” and “intro,” all of which mean what they mean, which is helpful.

Nutritional guidance may be included, excluded, or separately included at an exclusive add-on that inclusively excludes confusion. Expect a plan that is both tailored and universal, backed by science in the same way I am backed by a chair.

In conclusion, F45 offers a comprehensive fitness experience that is indisputably something. If you’re looking for a program that promises results while revealing nothing, a membership with tiers that exist in a Schrödinger’s box of value, and classes that do happen—look no further. Or actually, do look further. But also look here. Look everywhere. You’ll find it in 45.

The place is spotless. Equipment top of the line. The coaches are amazing and the rest of the staff the same!!
I have found a love for rowing.
I am so grateful for being invited by my neighbor and for all the people that help make Row House an incredible experience.
I know that after 15 years of trying different workouts that left me hurting and in pain that I have found my match. I know that I can get back into the shape I want to be in and achieve it with no pain. An answer to prayers!!
To those of you that don’t know this, rowing is the 2nd best thing to swimming. I can say from my experience, that no doubt it is the best workout I have had in a very long time!
The best part is that any one of any age can do it and you can make it your own!!
Thank you Row House for all that you do. I am so grateful for all of you!! 😄💪🏼💕

This has been the best thing I've done for myself.  Not only do I feel stronger, my mood is significantly elevated, my balance is much better, my sleep greatly improved.

Joel, my trainer, has been awesome.  He is right there the entire session, telling me what to do and how exactly to do it best, always challenging me to go a step further with weights and endurance.  I don't have to think at all as Joel chooses the workout, always working on different body parts, ensuring a well-rounded session and making the entire workout fun; it flies by.  He is extremely knowledgeable in his field and instinctively knows how to push me just enough to keep it effective, yet enjoyable. (Can't believe I said that!) This is a priceless investment in my health, and I'm so grateful 3 Form is here to work with me.

I've moved around a lot as an adult for work and have joined a lot of different gyms dating back to 2008.  CFPG is a very woman and age friendly place which isn't always common in the CrossFit world.  I've been members of gyms that would hide the 35 lbs "women's" barbells behind the 45 lbs barbells to make the gym look tougher, or not offer a scaled workout for new people, or insist on signing you up for training sessions before you can show up to a regular WOD...CFPG is not that kind of place.

If you are thinking about CrossFit or are intimidated by it, sign up for one of their SWEAT Bootcamps and see what it is all about.  CrossFit is for everybody.

The coach, McKenzie, is just amazing — super knowledgeable and truly cares about everyone’s health and where each person is in their CrossFit journey. No matter how difficult the workout or how different the background of each person in the class, she personalizes the routine for everyone and helps them grow. In a short period of time, I’ve noticed a lot of improvement and results on my end across different aspects: technique, endurance (cardio), strength (how much I lift), and even recovery and sleep. I track my sleep, recovery, and other metrics using a Whoop, and the numbers just keep getting better and more balanced with my life.

I’d also like to add that all the gym equipment is brand new, super nice — and I love the sauna and cold plunge areas. The bathrooms are clean and great for a shower after a workout. I can’t recommend this gym enough to everyone who wants to improve their health and have fun along the way.

Because the sauna/cold plunge area is a small co-ed environment, clear behavioral rules and active oversight are essential for women to feel comfortable.

I ultimately cancelled my membership and hope the spa implements clearer policies so all guests can feel safe using the facilities.

Celene, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback and for being a member with us. We truly appreciated having you as part of the BioLIT community and are grateful for the kind words about our team.

Our contrast therapy area is designed as a shared co-ed space, and we understand that this type of environment may not be the right fit for everyone. We do have expectations in place regarding appropriate attire and respectful guest behavior, which are communicated during visits and clearly posted within the contrast therapy room.

We’re proud that the vast majority of our members and guests consistently respect these guidelines and contribute to a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere. That said, we always take concerns seriously and will continue reinforcing our standards to ensure all guests feel at ease.

Nicole , Karen & the BioLIT Spa Team 💛

sync into sound.name: Serene R
sync into sound.text:
This review is long past due.

Last year, hurricane Milton flooded my home. As a licensed mental health  professional I was also providing crisis services to families and children displaced due to the inundation of repeated storms. Lucy, from Sync Into sound was offerring help for victims.

I quickly realized I, myself, was experiencing post acute stress symptoms and my nervous system was shot. I was not okay. My profession has taught me that it is OKAY to be NOT okay. I was truly concerned that my coping abilities were compromised and knew well enough that I needed relief, and quickly, so I could continue to help others. I had participated in singing bowl meditations in yoga before but read about her, and this was much more than that.

I barely remember but I believe I may have practically fallen through that front door of Sync Into  Sound after a long grueling day of working with families suffering. Lucy immediately provided me with a safe space to "fall." She worked her craft with the skill and expertise of a gifted scientist. I immediately felt releif. IMMEDIATELY.

Basically. I had known enough about trauma treatment, neuroplasticity, and the neurobiological body/brain stress response to understand that I was in trouble... i also experienced her healing techniques were instantly going to work on the neuronets within my brain.

Lucy is a healer who knows what she is doing. I can attest that I walked out of her office in a completely peaceful relaxed state. NOT the same person who walked in.  It blew my mind. But here's the kicker. It stayed with me. So there is also efficacy in the longevity of this technique.

The year got away from me as far as getting around to writing this, but here I am almost a year later and I am still blown away. I will NEVER forget my lived experience with the benefits of this technique and I WILL be back.

So whether you are physically and/or emotionaly healthy, healing, or NOT okay, I am telling you RUN. don't walk, into the arms of Sync Into Sound. You will be beyond grateful. And Lucy, I am STILL even feeing overall so very much better, as I am aware you even tapped into some of my old warrior battle scars.

You, my dear, are a very gifted, purposeful, and talented human. Thank you. 💛
sync into sound.responseFromOwnerText: Wow Serene! I am blown away reading this from a year beyond. So kind of you to take time and deeply remember. It all remains in our cells…the hurt, but then the healing if we give ourselves to it. Thank you!!

On top of that, I had no function in my toes ( couldn't wiggle them) and my right ankle would twist outward whenever I ran; which seem strange to me.My mile times use to be in the low 5-minute miles and was now in the mid-6’s— which was a major red flag that something was wrong.

I had tried yoga for flexibility, but it didn’t address the deeper issues.... Thankfully, my girlfriend suggested Pilates, and that’s when things turned around. I started working with Bianca, who was able to pinpoint the root of my problems: bad sciatica and a weak core. Through targeted exercises, she helped me rebuild my strength. I’m now back to training every day, pain-free with constant management, and I owe it to Pilates.

sarasota scoliosis & backcare.text:
Jane is amazing! I have been working with her for more than six months, and she is slowly but surely transforming my posture.

In the last couple of years, I started having back pain from my s-curve (scoliosis) and noticed that my posture looked terrible. One shoulder was curving forward, and I was having trouble standing up straight and tall for long periods of time. Given that I work on TV, this was a big problem!

Jane does her homework before your first session. She asked for x-rays or any information I had about my spine. When I came in for my first session, she clearly had a plan. In fact, Jane has a specific plan for every session. Each one is a little different, but all involve stretching, traction and exercises to strengthen specific muscles. My body and my mind are learning how to stand straighter and be more balanced. She challenges me, but also makes it fun.

My confidence and comfort are both being boosted! I have spent my life trying to hide my curvy spine. It feels so good to be addressing it and doing what I can to improve it. My goal is to stand tall for decades to come.

I feel so lucky to have discovered Jane. Now, I can travel the world without packing boxes of IcyHot patches to recover from long flights. And I don’t start slouching after hours on my feet on set. Jane is incredibly knowledgeable and kind. She is the first person I have ever been comfortable discussing my back issues with. I look forward to seeing her every week!
sarasota scoliosis & backcare.responseFromOwnerText: Oh my gosh, I am teary eyed but also smiling. Thank you Cindy. This work is very meaningful to me and I'm so happy that it is helping you.

I trust her blindly , when I have backpain, when my shoulders feel tight or even when I have migraines, she always has an answer and her practice brings strenght relief and peace in my body and mind . Even now that we live far apart I cannot imagine not having her in my life and the remote classes are always the highlights for my back , body and mind .

sarasota scoliosis & backcare.text: I have been working with Jane for several years now. Her knowledge and skills are honestly unmatched. In addition to aging issues, I have scoliosis. She actually designed lesson plans to suit your individual condition. Even when I travel for long periods of time, she sends me videos of exercises to do on my own without any yoga prompts. I very much appreciate her professionalism and dedication to her unique specialty; and highly recommend her to anyone in any age group.

sarasota scoliosis & backcare.title: Sarasota Scoliosis & Backcare

sarasota scoliosis & backcare.name: Traci Howell
sarasota scoliosis & backcare.text: Jane is amazing! I started seeing her after I received an osteoporosis diagnosis. I also came to her with mild scoliosis and an impingement in my left shoulder. crossfit anna maria.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
One of the best drop-in experiences I’ve ever had!

I dropped into Anna Maria Island CrossFit over the weekend while visiting, and this gym was awesome from the moment I walked in. The facility is clean, well-equipped, and the programming was solid—but what really stood out was how welcoming the regulars were. Felt like I was part of the community right away.

There was a little confusion with the class sign-ups on the app, and I accidentally paid for more sessions than I needed. As soon as the owners noticed, they personally texted me, apologized, and immediately issued a refund—no hassle at all. You don’t see that kind of integrity and customer care often.

Businesses like this are what it’s all about. Thank you for making it so easy and enjoyable to drop in. Can’t wait to come back next time I’m on the island!

I’ve been training in gyms for over 40 years. I started back in the day at the original Gold’s Gym on 14th Street and competed all through my 20s. Back then, there was a sign on the wall that said: "If it’s too heavy to put down, it’s too heavy to pick up." It was simple—don't slam the weights.

Fast forward 40 years, and it’s mind-boggling to see people leaving "offended" reviews because this gym has signs asking for basic common courtesy. If you’re an adult and you’re upset by a sign telling you to put your weights back, stop hogging machines while scrolling on your phone, or quit leaving messy chalk everywhere, then you are a fragile manchild who still expects his mom to pick up after him.

The reality is that a lot of people today just don’t get that gym etiquette even exists. It does. And every serious person in the gym expects it from you.   It is unbelievably rude to every other paying member when a group of guys leaves four sets of dumbbells scattered around a bench(Lifestyles) or someone sits on a machine for 15 minutes between sets staring at a screen (Crunch Fitness). If an owner puts up a sign to educate you on how to act, that’s not "being rude"—it’s trying to maintain a professional environment for everyone else.
the bar health & fitness.responseFromOwnerText: YES! THANK YOU! We want the gym to be a great environment for everyone!

befitsrq.name: Jonas Barr
befitsrq.text:
I've been exercising at BeFitSRQ every week for almost four months now, and I must say that I have never felt better about my body than I do now. I have more muscle definition, more strength in my body, and a more positive outlook of my body which, in effect, has helped my self-esteem. As an 18 year old teenager, this is indeed quite a feat that I feel compelled to share with others.

Having Michele guide me through various exercises in such a compassionate yet encouraging manner has proven to be absolutely delightful. When I first began exercising at BeFit, I could immediately tell that Michele has a genuine passion for physical training. The energy in her studio is so vibrant and uplifting that I feel compelled to work harder and harder during my sessions. As a matter of fact, I look forward to work out every single week (almost to the point where I jump in excitement as I receive a confirmation of my appointment in my e-mail inbox).

Since I began my sessions at BeFitSRQ, I feel more comfortable in my own skin. Most days, for me, it has now become a regular occurrence where I find that I am looking in the mirror staring at myself and thinking, "Wow, what a handsome devil this man is." Then I realise that this 'handsome devil' is me, and I smile at the fact that I look at myself in a loving manner.

Not only have I gained more muscle definition, but I've gained a sense of self and become more body-positive. I never thought that I would make it to this point in my life, but thanks to Michele, I can now say that I am closer than ever before to getting there.
befitsrq.address: 330 S Pineapple Ave STE 202, Sarasota, FL 34236
befitsrq.title: BeFitSRQ

befitsrq.name: Joani
befitsrq.text:
What an incredible workout with a trainer, Michele, who never takes her eyes off of you! So you never "hurt" yourself and she pushes you to unexpected goals!
Beside herself, she offers Dr. Hsin Hsin Hu, an acupuncturist, herbalist and truly caring person who figures out your ills and helps you get healthy!
Then of course, a yoga teacher, Mary Kane, who for me was teaching me to breathe, somehow I forgot!
Need a massage, just ask Michele and she will gladly help you find the right massage therapist, to soothe the aches and pains of life.
You need UV protective clothing, one stop shop, and it is beautiful with a variety of styles and colors to choose from for the amazing body you are working on.
Diffusers for the essential oils, Michele offers, so when you get home to relax and hydrate you can calm the mind and body with a choice of the most perfect smells.
Do you think I love this studio, you BEFITSRQ!
befitsrq.address: 330 S Pineapple Ave STE 202, Sarasota, FL 34236
befitsrq.title: BeFitSRQ

befitsrq.name: Erika Wise Borland
befitsrq.text: Perfect for a whole body workout when short on time and love the Doterra oils selection. Great atmosphere and venue.

befitsrq.title: BeFitSRQ

befitsrq.name: Lana Murphy
befitsrq.text: Words can not even describe how wonderful three days at Michele's BeFit SRQ made me feel!  After speaking with one of Michele's clients about Hsin-Hsin Hu and her cupping techniques I decided to set up an appt. and give it a try.  Hsin-Hsin spent over an hour 1/2 on her cupping skills making sure I was comfortable.  She educated me on the functions of the organs of the body and sent me home with Chinese Herbs.  I can really feel the difference after a week of the herbs.  (My food cravings are gone!) The following day, I made time for  yoga practice by Mary.  Mary spent the entire hour holding poses, correcting when needed and was very encouraging the entire time in a very peaceful setting.  I loved her selection of music - so calming - by the time I left I just felt so chill!  I also worked out with Michele, who has been training me for a year now.  Michele has got a great eye for what your body needs and what it is lacking.  She not only listensto my complaints and worries about my back, but she gives me great advice,  watches and makes sure I am doing my exercises properly and safely by guiding me.  I really like the hands on feel I receive from this fabulous trio of Michele, Mary and Hsin-Hsin.  I truly feel with the combination of all three involved I actually worked out the inside of my body to its true potential and feel great on the outside - Thank you Michele, Mary and Hsin-Hsin.   Michele, I love the additions to your studio!!  BeFitSRQ is my new prescription for heath!!
befitsrq.address: 330 S Pineapple Ave STE 202, Sarasota, FL 34236
befitsrq.title: BeFitSRQ

befitsrq.name: Leann

A great way to start the day and very competitively priced.

seaward crossfit.name: Jacqueline Dobbs
seaward crossfit.text:
This place is truly one of a kind. My husband and I have been members of—and associated with—other gyms in the Sarasota area for nearly a decade, and none of them come close to what Seaward offers. The culture, the owners, the coaches, the members, and the values of this gym are simply unmatched.

Every gym claims to have a great “community,” but words are just words until you actually feel it. At Seaward, that sense of genuine community is real and palpable from the moment you walk in. This culture starts with the owners, who have built something incredibly special through their thoughtful hiring of coaches, the way they nurture members, and the values they uphold. The members that this culture attracts create a tribe that makes the gym feel like a second home, and the atmosphere is one where everyone—whether a longtime member or an out-of-town drop-in—feels welcome, supported, and encouraged. Coaches and members alike go out of their way to introduce themselves, learn about you, cheer you on, and make sure you leave feeling better than when you arrived.

Personally, I started at Seaward while pregnant with my first child, and I cannot imagine having gone through that journey anywhere else. From my pregnancy through my postpartum recovery, the support, encouragement, and care I’ve experienced here has been beyond anything I could have hoped for. My husband, my child, and I feel truly blessed and grateful to have gained a second family through this gym.

If you are looking for a place that is more than just a workout—one that will lift you up, challenge you, and surround you with people who genuinely care—Seaward CrossFit is it.
seaward crossfit.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, Jackie! Thanks so much for the review. It really means a lot to hear such positive comments. We are very lucky to have you and your family as part of the community.
seaward crossfit.title: Seaward CrossFit

I’ve been working with Adrian for a  little  over 4 months now. And WOW, I’m seeing some real solid improvement. I heard about Body Reform Fitness, Adrian  and his EMS workouts. I needed help and  a change so I decided to go all in with Adrian.  And am I  happy I did.  I have seen pretty dramatic physical and strength changes from working with him . Bad knees had limited my mobility and agility. I’m now back to running on a treadmill  ( first time on 30+ yrs) and I’m playing 2 hrs a day of competive PickleBall 5 days a week. My strength and fitness are significantly improved while body fat and  weight are down to impressive ( high school) numbers.  And all this with only 2 EMS workouts a week.

Adrian is an amazing trainer, coach, motivator and friend. He’s super knowledgable and really listens to what Im trying to accomplish. Ive used trainers in the past but didn’t feel I was getting what I needed.

Adrian keeps me focused and motivated . The workouts are hard but progress is noticeable and impressive.  And all with just 2 EMS 20 minute workouts a week.  I’m no longer the gym rat spending hours a day at the gym. Workout hard and focus on recovery  is what Adrian has convinced me is the key …

You won’t find a more knowledgable, caring and dedicated trainer around. And BTW Tyler just teamed up with Adrian. The two of them are going to improve the lives of lots of people in Sarasota.

chicaboom fitness sarasota.name: Susan Dinsmore
chicaboom fitness sarasota.text:
I’m so grateful to have found Taylor at Chica Boom.
While I was searching for a gym to get stronger and healthier, I felt a little lost at the giant fitness centers.
Taylor, a nurse by training, carefully considers what I’m able to do as a more ‘mature’ woman with back issues. She’s great at modifying the exercises for me as we build stamina. With the increased physical strength, I feel greater mental energy and resolve.
I look forward to each class knowing she will gently push me to do more while keeping safety in mind - she is truly amazing!
chicaboom fitness sarasota.title: ChicaBoom Fitness Sarasota

chicaboom fitness sarasota.name: Juliet J
chicaboom fitness sarasota.text:
I’ve had the pleasure of being a client at Chicaboom for the past five months, and it has truly reignited my passion for fitness. Before joining, I had lost motivation and fallen out of love with the gym. After moving nearby, I decided to give Chicaboom a try based on their social media and great reviews, and I’m so glad I did.

Wendy and her team of trainers are incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and motivating. The plateau I had been stuck in quickly disappeared, and my love for working out returned. Not only did I get back into a consistent routine, but I also started seeing real results I had been chasing for a long time.

With a background in fitness myself, I can confidently say that Chicaboom offers top-tier training at very reasonable prices. I’m so grateful to have found this amazing gym and highly recommend it to anyone looking to build confidence, stay consistent, and finally see the results they’ve been working toward.
chicaboom fitness sarasota.title: ChicaBoom Fitness Sarasota

chicaboom fitness sarasota.name: Joe Catanzaro
chicaboom fitness sarasota.text: I'm 6 months into a fulltime one on one schedule with Wendy. I'm down 25 pounds of fat and in the best shape I've been in years. She creates a fun but accountable atmosphere that's motivating and rewarding. The nutrition plan that Wendy creates for me each month has been key to my overall success, learning what I should eat and when. Weekly Inbody scans at the office allows me to see the measurable changes in my body with fat loss and muscle gain. I credit her for my success this year so far. If you're looking to make a change in your health, I recommend signing up with Wendy.
chicaboom fitness sarasota.title: ChicaBoom Fitness Sarasota

chicaboom fitness sarasota.name: Nina Alcantara
chicaboom fitness sarasota.text: Chica Boom has been the best decision I’ve made in a long time. When I was feeling at my lowest I was able to find a place where I could not only strengthen my body and train harder than I ever have but I also found a group of people who are kind, motivating and so lovely! The trainers are all incredible and even though I was nervous about working out it has turned into the best part of my week! I always leave feeling proud and happy💓

Wendy makes those pics below to show me my progress during a month, assisting 3 times per week. I was astonished and surprised when i see them, that i couldn’t believe it. Chicaboom and the beautiful girl that told me to give it a try, changes my life for good. Also, Tylor, and Carlos, are very good trainers too. I’m truly happy to be part of this amazing gym. chicaboom fitness sarasota.name: Adailin Marcinkiewicz

This program has completely changed my way of life for the better, picking up good habits and learning how to eat properly are just a couple of the things I’ve been able to learn through this process.
Wendy has been so attentive to helping me reach my goals and keeping me on track!
Between Wendy and Nasiel, I’ve been able to really enjoy working out weekly and I really look forward to training days!
I’ve also had the privilege to train with Taylor and Tedra who are just as amazing !
They are extremely knowledgeable and accommodating to everyone’s specific needs.

Thank you for changing my life girls!
Happy to be part of the Chica family !

crossfit 727.name: Jeb Slick
crossfit 727.text:
I can’t recommend CrossFit 727 enough! As someone who had always been intimidated by CrossFit and its movements, I was hesitant to give it a try. But from the moment I walked into the gym, I felt completely at ease. The coaches are incredible—patient, knowledgeable, and able to break down complex movements into simple, easy-to-understand steps. Whether you’re a beginner or more experienced, the classes are designed to cater to all ability levels. I’ve seen beginners and extremely impressive athletes challenge themselves.

What really sets this gym apart is the community. Everyone is so welcoming and supportive, and it’s clear that the members genuinely care about each other’s progress. There’s also a fantastic social scene, making it not just a place to work out but a place to connect and have fun. On top of that, the facilities are top-notch, with everything you need for a great workout. If you're looking for a supportive, friendly, and well-equipped CrossFit gym, CrossFit 727 is the place to be!
crossfit 727.title: CrossFit 727

crossfit 727.name: Ryan Alphonse
crossfit 727.text:
I recently moved to the St. Pete area and discovered CrossFit727, and my experience has been nothing short of amazing. The coaches are enthusiastic, patient, and truly committed to helping you improve, whether you’re new to this style of workout or experienced.

But it’s more than just a gym—it’s a community. The members are incredibly supportive, hold you accountable, and make every visit not only enjoyable but also a safe and welcoming space.

If you’re looking for a place to challenge yourself, learn, and connect with great people, CrossFit727 is the place to be!
crossfit 727.title: CrossFit 727

crossfit 727.name: Phillip Gisoldi
crossfit 727.text: I've been a member at 727 for 4 years but this review is 4 yrs too late. If I had one regret with 727, it's that I didn't join the gym sooner when I moved to the area 7 years ago. I had never tried CrossFit before and was hesitant because of the stereotypes and the stigma CrossFit carries. 727 erased all my concerns and hesitations. I can't speak for other gyms but at this gym, the coaches are well-trained, personable, and have the utmost situational awareness which you need if you're going to be a successful gym, coaching that many people of different levels of fitness. I feel safe doing the workouts and I've made lifelong friends in my 4 years here. I highly recommend that if you're reading this review, you give 727 a call and drop in for a class. It's a very welcoming atmosphere and Ryan along with the other coaches has built a strong and supportive community amongst its members. I'll also add that I'm in the best shape of my life mentally and physically since I joined!
crossfit 727.title: CrossFit 727

crossfit 727.name: Geneva Postiglione
crossfit 727.text: I love this gym. I tried several CrossFit gyms in the St. Pete area and none made me feel more at home than this one. I've been working out here for a little over a year, and I am so happy with how much I have improved. The coaches are very knowledgeable and make me feel safe with the movements we practice before the WOD. Even with bad knees, they are always there to help me modify the workout to fit my needs. Very clean facilities and one of the few gyms in St. Pete with AC - a very important detail for those hot Florida summers!

He could have easily taken my money without any regard for how I fared or how well I liked the classes. I will say after attending, I may need to work up to something like this. However, the environment here and the fitness level of the others is really giving me encouragement to take care of myself so I can return and be part of such an awesome community.

longboat key fitness.name: Jeff Rizzo
longboat key fitness.text: We were staying on Longboat Key last season and we found this gem of a gym and joined for our time on island.  Meeting the owner Petar he instantly makes you feel welcome, and he is truly passionate about fitness and your experience.  Very clean, friendly people and great fitness equipment.  Getting to know Petar and Heather was a highlight of our trip last year and we miss going to LBK Fitness.  Fast forward to this year, while not able to stay on the Key this year, but my 75-year-old mother and 80-year-old father I got in for personal training sessions with Petar and Heather while they were visiting for two weeks.  I am beyond grateful for the compassion and time spent helping my parents focusing on exercises and stretches to keep mobility and balance.  For my father Petar recognized his strength imbalance that was my concern for him falling.  Petar, Heather, Kitty the inhouse Physical Therapist deserve way more than 5 stars.  They are great at what they do, and the blessing is they are also amazing people who actually care.  Thank you for all you do!!

caged crossfit.name: Audrey C.
caged crossfit.text:
I joined Cage CrossFit about a year ago after not doing CrossFit since college, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience getting back into it.

From day one, the gym was incredibly welcoming. The coaches genuinely care — not just about your performance, but about you as a person. Even if you’re a true beginner, there’s no intimidation factor. The community is supportive, encouraging, and truly wants to see everyone succeed.

As a woman, I’ll also say that gyms can sometimes feel intimidating — but I never experienced that here. I never once felt uncomfortable or treated differently. Every class had women in it, the environment felt inclusive, and the coaching was always respectful and empowering.

The coaches clearly care about building a real community, not just running workouts. They’re attentive, knowledgeable, and invested in helping members grow at their own pace.

I’m unfortunately relocating and have to leave, but they were extremely understanding about my cancellation and communicated their policies clearly and professionally.

If I’m ever back in the St. Pete area, I would rejoin in a heartbeat. Highly recommend to anyone — whether you’re brand new or coming back after time away.
caged crossfit.title: Caged CrossFit

caged crossfit.name: Evan Williams
caged crossfit.text: My wife and I joined Caged CrossFit in Clearwater two years ago and absolutely love it. The community is unmatched, the motivation is real, and as a veteran, the camaraderie here was huge to me. Highly recommend this gym for anyone looking for more than just a workout.

caged crossfit.name: Volkan
caged crossfit.text:
Excessive early cancellation membership charges.
Completed attendings: 17months.
2 stars: For the coaches. They were great.
1 star: For the experiences. It was great.
2 stars off: For the miscommunications, and the misinformation, especially with the cancellation fee requirements.
Note: In the beginning, $10 for the early cancellation fee for each month of the rest of the 6 months membership. In the end, then it was $25. Then, I ended up getting charged for $100 for the last month of the membership.
Because of the cancellation fee experience, I will not be returning.
caged crossfit.responseFromOwnerText: I’m sorry you feel this way Volkan. Our cancellation process & fee has been the same for 3 years and is clearly outlined in your contract and cancellation form. You also told me this was explained to you well by our head coach and that you filled out the form together. We loved having you as an athlete and as part of our community and you will be missed!

I asked for a manager and one was not provided after numerous requests. The staff informed me that they would cancel the membership for me then and there and also put in a request for a refund. That never happened. After waiting another week or two I went in again because no one followed up with me like they said they would. Turns out they never cancelled the membership the second time I went into the gym. I asked for a manager again and still, one was not provided. I was then told that the regional manager would reach out to me regarding this matter. And yet again, no one has bothered to respond back. This is by far, the WORST, and I truly mean the worst gym I have ever been a member of. The staff is incredibly rude and inconsiderate, and makes you feel as if they don't care about what you have to say. I do not recommend this gym, at all.

If you're willing, please contact the club directly and ask for our regional support team so we can prioritize your case and complete the cancellation and refund review promptly. What really sets it apart though is the vibe and the people. The staff is friendly and helpful, and everyone there is focused and driven — it pushes you to be better without feeling intimidating.

If you’re serious about getting in shape or just want a gym that actually gets you excited to work out, Amped Fitness in Bradenton is 100% the place to be.

Jazzercise is the best kind of exercise I have ever done.
If you love to dance but don’t want to go to a gym, this is for you.  Our dances incorporate cardio with strength training, resistance and balance.
If the idea of forming a welcoming, smiling “gang” to exercise with and love the idea of finding some new friends as a bonus, this is for you.  Our leader makes everyone feel included  and is always creating special events and activities to create our community.
And here in Venice and Sarasota, we are blessed to have the absolutely best teacher in the world Karen Schroll.   Even if you don’t have a sense of rhythm, her cueing steps is perfect.  Even if you feel self conscious dancing, no one cares and no one compares - we’re all at different levels.  And there is absolutely no embarrassment or shame, she speaks in terms of “high intensity” or “low intensity” when curing steps - no suggestion of can you or can’t you do a step.
This is exercise!?  This is fun!!
6806126459982857258.responseFromOwnerText: Nina we can't thank you enough for this GLOWING review!  We are SO grateful for this incredible community & that YOU are in it!  & we love that you feel safe & confident & welcomed in classes because that is what we strive for!

3702949338847356143.name: Angelica Ventimiglia
3702949338847356143.text:
Working with Josh has been absolutely life-changing. With his guidance, support, and expertise, I have lost 75 pounds and am now in the best shape of my life.

His training approach is thoughtful, motivating, and focused not just on weight loss, but on building strength, mobility, and confidence. Because of his program, I now have the stamina, flexibility, and conditioning needed to train and compete in ballroom dance at a high level.

What truly sets him apart is how invested he is in his clients success. He pushes you to become stronger while always making sure your form, safety, and long-term health come first.

Thanks to Josh’s training, my performance, endurance, and overall physical ability have improved tremendously. I feel stronger, more energized, and more confident every day, and it has made a huge difference in my training and performance on the dance floor.

I’m incredibly grateful for his support and highly recommend Josh to anyone looking to improve their fitness and elevate their performance
3702949338847356143.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for trusting me and putting in the work! I’m so proud of you and blessed to have you as a client!

I booked the ALIGN class through ClassPass and it was one of the most fun and challenging yoga classes I’ve taken in a while.

The teacher did an amazing job of cueing us and offering mods for both beginners and more advanced yogis. Classroom was heated but not to an uncomfortable level. Also the floor has mat space markers which really helps keep the room spaced out properly in a bigger class.

I parked behind the building in the paid spots but I’m curious if there’s free street parking. That would be a bonus if there was free parking nearby.

Otherwise this studio is lovely and I can’t wait to go back to for ALIGN and some of the other classes soon!

If you’re looking for yoga that goes beyond poses and actually transports you somewhere calmer, look no further!

I will for sure visit every time I am in town and I encourage everyone else to do so.  If you are looking for a yoga home, OM Body Studios is the place to be.  Scheduling is easy online and the pricing is great.

6443751817354431774.name: Jenny Ferraro
6443751817354431774.text:
This Yoga Teacher Training was one of the most meaningful things I’ve done for myself in a very long time. After years of pouring my energy into raising my children and taking care of everyone else, I felt a quiet pull to finally do something just for me. Signing up for this training ended up being such a gift.

The experience was so much more than learning how to teach yoga poses. It became a journey of self-discovery, personal growth, and reconnecting with myself in a deeper way. I gained confidence, a deeper understanding of the practice, and a real appreciation for the philosophy behind yoga.

Another unexpected gift was the group of people I went through the training with. We supported each other through the entire journey, and I truly feel like the friendships formed during this training will last a lifetime.

I’m especially grateful for the encouragement and guidance from Marina. Her knowledge, patience, and passion for yoga created such a supportive environment to learn and grow.

I left this training not only feeling prepared to teach, but also feeling stronger, more grounded, and inspired in my own life. I’m incredibly grateful for the experience and would recommend this training to anyone who feels that quiet whisper inside telling them it’s time to grow.
6443751817354431774.title: Thavma Yoga Lakewood Ranch

6443751817354431774.name: Michael VanBuskirk
6443751817354431774.text: I had been through a traumatic injury back in October. I shattered my heel and burst my L1 in my back. Through PT and the right medication, I recovered pretty quickly.  However it was getting back to Thavma that helped me gain all my confidence back.  I started back at TY in early January and by early March I was skiing again! This had nothing to do with PT and everything to do with Marina and her teacher’s core and balance work.  Thanks Thavma, for getting me back to my true passion. Skiing!!!
6443751817354431774.title: Thavma Yoga Lakewood Ranch

6443751817354431774.name: Jasmine Hasler
6443751817354431774.text: I had such a great experience today at Thavma Yoga in Lakewood Ranch. It was my first time at the studio and my very first heated yoga class and I honestly couldn’t have felt more welcomed. The energy in the studio immediately put me into a good vibe which was especially helpful since I wasn’t sure what to expect as a first timer. The class was challenging — but in the best way. It pushed me & of course, made me sweat, but it was also fun and empowering. Marina, the owner and instructor, is incredible. She has this way about her that makes the class feel intentionally personal, almost like you’re getting a one-on-one session. She thoughtfully corrects posture and encourages you to go a little deeper but in a non judgmental, motivating way. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and proud of myself!  It's only been an hour and I’m already looking through my schedule for the week ahead to plan my next visit! Her cute puppies also added an extra endorphin boost <3
6443751817354431774.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review 🤍
We’re truly honored you chose Thavma for your very first heated yoga experience,that’s a big step, and we’re so glad you felt welcomed and supported from the moment you walked in.
Marina’s whole passion behind creating Thavma is for people to feel exactly what you felt , that powerful shift from uncertainty to strength, from just “getting through” a workout to truly connecting to your body. After rebuilding her own body through injury, her mission became helping others feel strong, capable, aligned, and confident in a way that lasts.
Hearing that you left feeling rejuvenated and proud of yourself means everything to us. That’s the Thavma effect!
And yes… the studio pups definitely are part of the experience 🐾
We can’t wait to have you back in the room soon. Welcome to the Thavma community,  you absolutely belong here.
6443751817354431774.title: Thavma Yoga Lakewood Ranch

6443751817354431774.name: Declan Keenan
6443751817354431774.text: Attending Thavma Yoga Studio worked wonders for my lower back pain. I strongly urge anyone with that problem to do the same. It wasn't instant gratification, took some time and persistence but the stretching and strengthening eventually paid off. I recently read that there are strong tendons which anchor the base of your spine. As we get older, these tendons can prevent the muscles in that area from moving correctly so they get more and more stiff and sore. It is essential to get these muscles moving again but in an educated and safe manner. I have told many people about this back pain (and more) cure which is available at Thavma. It's there waiting!
6443751817354431774.responseFromOwnerText: Declan, thank you so much for taking the time to share this. Your words truly mean a lot to us. We love that you highlighted the importance of patience and consistency—real, lasting change in the body happens when movement is done with intention and education, not shortcuts. Seeing you regain mobility, strength, and confidence in your back is exactly why Thavma exists. Thank you for trusting the process and for sharing it with others. We’re so grateful to have you as part of our community 🤍
